name: rank-2-stamp-raised
instruction: KEYFRAME: She has lifted the stamp a little ABOVE the paperwork, preparing to press it. Wrist rises just a few centimeters above the page, forearm naturally bends. The lower face of the small stamp hovers about a palm-height over the ledger. No exaggerated gesture, no raising hand near the face. The movement should fit within the space between her sleeve and the ledger.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, registered animation keyframe.
Input is the RANK 2 base plate. Output one full identical tall portrait canvas. Change ONLY the woman's writing-side forearm, hand and held implement in the tiny lower-right office. This is a precise fixed-camera animation pose, not a redesign.
Keep her head and mask, BLACK long hair, torso, other arm, clothes, body position, size, desk, all forms and ledger, light, architecture, background and water pixel-aligned with the input. All changes limited to the immediate working hand/forearm and brush/stamp resting spot. Keep her FOX MASK fully over the FRONT of her face; do not touch head or mask.

name: rank-2-stamp-pressed
instruction: KEYFRAME: She gently presses the stamp vertically DOWN onto the form near the open ledger. The base of the stamp touches the paper, her fingers wrap the little handle naturally, wrist slightly lower, forearm from the same elbow remains relaxed. The gesture is small and restrained. Add only a very small red rectangular approval mark directly beneath the stamp, no readable characters.
